summary: [SPECULATIVE ESTIMATE] KERNEL CONTEST: The foundational Vedic texts (the formalized, unchangeable textual kernel) read by orthodox authorities as an absolute, literal mandate defining the Varna hierarchy (an extractive mechanism) versus read by reformist movements as purely spiritual, metaphorical, and non-prescriptive. Because the text itself cannot be revised, all conflict migrates into the authority-grounding of its interpretation.

[SPECULATIVE ESTIMATE] KERNEL CONTEST: Wikipedia's formalized notability guidelines (the codified practice-norm kernel) read by 'deletionists' as a strict, necessary filter ensuring encyclopedic purity and preventing epistemic commons degradation (a coordination Rope) versus read by 'inclusionists' as an extractive gatekeeping mechanism that systematically erases marginalized knowledge structures (a Snare). The exact same text generates different beneficiary and victim sets.

[SPECULATIVE ESTIMATE] KERNEL CONTEST: The World Trade Organization's dispute resolution mechanism (the shared institutional kernel) read by globalization proponents as a binding, neutral referee necessary for international trade (a Scaffold/Rope) versus read by nationalist/protectionist regimes as an illegitimate, overreaching infringement on sovereign trade policy. The contest dictates whether the authority structure can enforce compliance at all[cite: 2, 3].

[SPECULATIVE ESTIMATE] KERNEL CONTEST: The public health mandate (the codified legal/administrative kernel) read as a public-health-primary obligation protecting the vulnerable commons versus a bodily-autonomy-primary violation of individual rights. Each reading emits a constraint with a radically different victim set (the immunocompromised-exposed vs. the unvaccinated-coerced)[cite: 1, 2].
